== Title ==
<span lang="ja">マーク・サンレット</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：盗賊以外のキャラクターに配備して盗賊の能力を与える。自分の支配フェイズに、同じ位置カード上にあるアイテムを1つ目標にできる。運命数を引く。運命数＜目標の運命数なら、それを“盗む”。2：武器か兵器に配備して、盗まれるのを防ぐ。（このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない）</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ティラック・ムンダ出身、頭が切れて気の良い泥棒。金持ちに雇われて、財産を護るための助言を与えることも多い。旅なれており、さまざまな言語に精通している。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Merc Sunlet]].

'''Lore''' — A clever, good-natured thief from Tirac Munda. The wealthy often hire him to advise on protecting property. He is well traveled and skilled in many languages.

'''Game text''' — Choose one. 1: Deploy on a non-thief to give thief skill. During your control phase, may target one Item at the same location card. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than the target's destiny, it is stolen. 2: Deploy on a weapon to prevent theft. This Effect is not affected by Alter.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese uses numbered choose-one. Device is アイテム at the same location card, not same site. Second function deploys on 武器か兵器. Immune clause names 意識操作 (Alter).<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-mercsunlet-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Merc Sunlet]].</ref>
